changelog:
Initial release of ai-persona-check:

- Launches a free compliance check for AI persona-based interactive services under China's new Interim Measures (effective 2026-07-15).
- Covers 10 core compliance items, with real-time cloud-based scoring from complianceHub.
- Free to install and use: anonymous trial allows 5 cloud-scored runs; register at compliancehub.cn for a free API Key (100 free calls).
- Supports full offline preview mode (--non-interactive), which does not send any data or require a Key.
- Ensures user answers are only sent to the cloud during scoring; no terminal-based account registration.
- Includes clear instructions, security notes, and legal disclaimer.
